descriptions.w3d_f3a_comment_8028ebe0: Reads the external CommentaryPanel.Comment property, appends the by-value input text to the offset-72 queue, appends the unsigned argument to the offset-120 deque with boundary growth, constructs a text wrapper from the property and appends it to the offset-92 queue, then releases both wrappers. Object roles and deque layout are inferred; external data ownership is not claimed.
